summary: The Mill Facing operation now plunges from the Safe Height to the cutting depth with a G1 feed move instead of a G0 rapid, and the linking generator gains an internal split-plunge argument and annotation to support this.

pages.reason: Path/Op/MillFacing.py: initial positioning plunge changed from Path.Command('G0', pre3) to G1, and the final linking move between pattern segments is forced to G1 with split_plunge_height=obj.SafeHeight.Value, so rapids stop at Safe Height and the descent to depth is at feed rate; this changes what the operation produces and what the Heights/CollisionAvoidanceStrategy properties imply

Path/Base/Generator/linking.py: new optional split_plunge_height argument and ANNOT_LINKING annotation are internal to the linking generator; the CAM Area page documents the Path.Area object, not this generator
Constants.py: adds ANNOT_LINKING = {"type": "linking"}, an internal annotation marker on generated commands; the Annotations section does not enumerate per-generator annotation constants

meta.title: CAM: MillFacing - G1 for plunge moves
